TRL 0.16 computes per-token KL as exp(ref_logp-policy_logp)-(ref_logp-policy_logp)-1; rare large finite log-probability gaps can dominate a 500-step mean. The subsequent aggregate recovered at step 4000, reward improved, and both model and optimizer states remained finite.
